name: commit-msg
description: Turns the work Claude just did into an accurate conventional commit message that matches your repo's recent commits, in a pane: pick subject only, with body or with footer; edit it, regenerate it with guidance, step through drafts and copy it. /commit-msg [simple|body|full] [note].

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that writes the message.

style.title: Default style
style.description: The message style the pane starts on: subject only, subject and body, or subject, body and footer.
